name: Nascent Pharma Holdings, Inc.
summary: Nascent Pharma Holdings, Inc. is primarily engaged in both protecting and bringing to market intellectual property pertaining to cannabis. Beyond this, the company also manufactures superfood beverage mixes, which are marketed under its "Longevity" brand. Established in 2005 and headquartered in Hicksville, New York, the firm previously operated as Can B Corp. and is slated to officially adopt the Nascent Pharma Holdings, Inc. name in September 2025.
